correctness.rationale: Quantifier elimination reduces complete 1-types over a finite meet-closed parameter tree to finite one-point extension diagrams. The standard one-point generation lemma leaves exactly three nonalgebraic geometric cases, each indexed by the m gaps/vertices, and the closure extremum follows inductively from the same lemma. An exhaustive finite checker confirms the extension-signature count for m<=4 and the closure inequality through seven vertices.

value.rationale: Finite-parameter type growth is a natural complexity invariant for an omega-categorical dp-minimal Fraisse theory. The exact 4|dcl(P)| formula and sharp 8n-4 envelope strengthen the qualitative polynomial count used in prior NIP arguments and isolate three geometric sources of nonalgebraic types.
